objective: Compare safe policies for brand-new identity discovery when FantasyPros and Sleeper disagree on position.
baseline_policy: Current production discovery policy: exact normalized name + compatible position + exact current team corroboration.

policy_arms.P1_GENERIC_EXACT_NAME_TEAM_OVERRIDE: If current strict discovery fails only because of position incompatibility, allow a new authoritative pair only when there is exactly one exact-name Sleeper candidate and its current team exactly matches FantasyPros.
policy_arms.P2_EVIDENCE_BACKED_EXPLICIT_OVERRIDE: Apply the same exact-name + exact-team requirement only to the three Phase 3 rows with non-ambiguous official position evidence: Austin Booker, Gabe Jacas, Kendal Daniels. Jonah Elliss remains held.

hard_gates_for_explicit_candidate: Phase 3 classifications for all four taxonomy rows must match the frozen expected classifications.
Each explicit target must have exactly one exact normalized-name Sleeper candidate.
Each explicit target candidate must have exact current team corroboration.
No explicit target may collide with another authoritative Sleeper assignment.
The explicit arm must change exactly the three frozen target FPIDs and zero unrelated FPIDs.
Jonah Elliss must remain unresolved by the explicit arm.
generic_arm_rule: P1 is diagnostic only in Phase 4. It cannot be promoted by this workflow regardless of blast radius.
explicit_arm_rule: A PASS may only authorize a separate production-candidate shadow phase; it does not authorize deployment.
